'''Bolesław Józef Fleszar''' (17 December 1933 – 30 November 2023) was a Polish chemist and politician. A member of the [[Solidarity Citizens' Committee]], he served in the [[Senate of Poland|Senate]] from 1989 to 1991.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ww2.senat.pl/k1/senat/Senator/fleszar.htm|title=Bolesław Fleszar|work=Senate of Poland|language=Polish}}</ref>

Fleszar died on 30 November 2023, at the age of 89.<ref>{{cite news |last=|first=|date=1 December 2023|title=Zmarł Bolesław Fleszar, senator I kadencji|trans-title= |url=https://www.senat.gov.pl/aktualnoscilista/art,15914,zmarl-boleslaw-fleszar-senator-i-kadencji.html|language=Polish|work=senat.gov.pl|location= |access-date=3 December 2023}}</ref>
